title: Imported metrics from freshly executed CMA-ES method trial
source: Original six synthetic cases run locally with cma4.4.0/numpy2.2.6; this receipt IMPORTS the saved results and does not rerun the optimizer. Not a paper table replication.

claims.statement: The imported metrics record success_fraction=1 for the six preselected cases. The experiment performs optimization separately; the sample checker validates saved numerical results and budget accounting before import, but does not authenticate execution. Paper Replay checks the imported numeric field only.
The imported worst_best_value is within 1e-8 of zero. Independent objective recomputation was performed by the separate sample checker before this snapshot was imported.
The imported run_count equals six. Exact objective/seed identities were checked by the separate sample checker before import; Paper Replay verifies this declared numeric field only.
